development_task.preprocessing: development-data mean and population standard deviation (ddof=0); replace constant scale with 1

internal_grouped_replay.interpretation: exploratory internal replay; fixed ridge did not outperform random expectation

blockers.detail: The source isolate endpoint table does not report the collection time for each titer label; do not infer it from the OD trajectory.
Previously replayed public panels use different organisms/products or different features and are not a strict test of the locked original model.
Availability of the corresponding parental strain, HPLC/UPLC capacity and prospective culture capacity has not been documented.
Requires pilot estimates of biological variance, assay precision and a predeclared practically meaningful titer gain.

next_gates: Verify the source endpoint collection time and culture/assay definition from the primary source or authors.
If endpoint semantics cannot be resolved, define a new fixed-time target and a new model protocol; do not call it validation of the original model.
Freeze an all-development-data ridge artifact and hashes before opening any external endpoint labels.
Run a powered independent-lineage validation and blinded, independent-culture retest against parent and random-selection controls.
